summary: Hardcoded bearer tokens grant admin bypass in exported auth middleware
details: The exported createAuthMiddleware in @decido/backend-core accepts two hardcoded literal bearer token strings ('mock-admin-token' and 'mock-token-123'). When a request presents either token, the middleware skips all signature/JWT verification and resolves req.user to the first user with role ADMIN (or a hardcoded UUID fallback) from the consumer's Prisma database, then calls next(). Any consumer that mounts createAuthRouter or createAuthMiddleware in their Express app exposes an unauthenticated path to full ADMIN privileges reachable by anyone able to send an HTTP Authorization header to the deployed service. The tokens are not disclosed in the package's public typings or description.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
